audience: shift managers and HR teams who run rosters, timesheets and leave in Humanforce WFM

useCases.title: Check who is rostered for a date range
useCases.text: List the rostered shifts between two dates, filtered by location, department or role. Check the locations and roles that the shifts use.

useCases.title: Find timesheets that need approval
useCases.text: List the timesheets in a date range, filtered by approval status. Open an employee record to check its roles and locations.

useCases.title: See who is clocked in right now
useCases.text: List the employees, then check whether each one is clocked in or out, in local time.

useCases.title: Review leave requests for a period
useCases.text: List the leave requests in a date range, or only the approved ones. Check the shift types to see which leave types apply.

useCases.title: Check pay setup before a payrun
useCases.text: List the pay companies, pay types and public holidays for a period. Use them to check the setup before a payrun.
